nodes.label: Heroslider Content Block Icon
nodes.description: SVG icon representing the heroslider content block. Design shows a bordered rectangular frame simulating a slide/card, with a top dark-gray text line, two lighter gray text lines below it, a blue image placeholder rectangle in the bottom-right quadrant containing a white mountain/landscape silhouette and a white circle (sun), and three short gray lines on the left side representing text content. Visually communicates a hero slider element combining an image area with text content area.

nodes.label: Heroslider ContentBlock
nodes.description: TYPO3 content block for a hero/banner image slider using Splide. Renders fullbleed hero slides with Tailwind CSS caption overlays replacing legacy Bootstrap .caption classes.
